pull.title: docs: carry every user-facing surface to 6.8.0
pull.body:
The 6.x arc rewrote key health (#216), the Limits page (#218), reasoning resolution (#219, #221, #222, #224), the request log (#220) and the Models page (#223). The documentation still described the system as it worked before 6.0.0 — a reader following the README or the in-dashboard Guide was being told to tune a circuit breaker that no longer exists.

Docs and screenshots only, plus the PATCH bump the versioning rule requires because `index.html` and the bundled images are production files.

## Audit — claim → still true at 6.8.0? → fix

### `README.md`

| Claim | True? | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "When rotation happens … authentication, rate limits, **5xx/overload**, and transport failures" | **No** — `error_justifies_rotation` rotates on 401/403, 429 and transport only | Rewritten to the three cases; added that `openai.APITimeoutError` is excluded *by name* despite subclassing `APIConnectionError` |
| `DESKTOP_*` editable from "Admin → Limits → Desktop" | **No** — moved to Providers at 6.2.0 | "Admin → Providers → Desktop", with the reason |
| Features row "**Limits** — deadlines, retry budgets and retention" | **No** — renamed and split at 6.2.0 | "Limits & Resilience", now naming the six cards and the calculator |
| `FALLBACK_EJECT_AFTER_FAILURES` presented as the benching rule | **No** — `FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR` defaults to `rate_based`; the count rule is `legacy`-only | Split into a benching table: `FALLBACK_BENCH_ENABLED` (true), `FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR` (rate_based), `_EJECT_WINDOW` (10), `_FAILURE_RATE` (0.5), `_MIN_SAMPLES` (8), `_AFTER_FAILURES` (3, legacy), `FALLBACK_RETRY_FIRST` (skip) |
| "three limits … all editable in Admin UI → Limits" (×2) | **No** | Retargeted to the exact cards |
| `FALLBACK_ON_REASONING_ONLY` / `_REASONING_ANSWER_TIMEOUT` "both in Admin UI → Models" | **No** — both are `deadlines` | Retargeted to Limits & Resilience → Deadlines |
| `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` absent from the health table | Gap | Row added: default `60`, header always wins, 1 h cap |
| Admin page list has neither Models nor Limits & Resilience | Stale | Both added; Analytics notes the `REQUEST_LOG_*` block now sits there |
| Output-budget prose implying the rung widens the allowance | Misleading | "The rung does not widen anything — the presence of reasoning does" |
| `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_CEILING` "`0` lifts it entirely" | True, thin | Added range `0…1048576`, the sentinel wording, and why it ships set (TPM pre-reservation on OpenAI/Azure-style limiters) |
| 10/30/60/120 ladder, circuit breaker, HALF_OPEN, `CREDENTIAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD`, `MIN_CREDENTIAL_FIRST_TOKEN_SECONDS`, "clamps to models.dev", "Save writes defaults into `.env`" | **Already absent** (grepped) | Only remaining mention is the new *delete this line* instruction |

**Added:** `### Limits & Resilience`, `### Saving Settings: Blank Means Unset`, `#### What Actually Left The Process`, bulk actions under Model Visibility, and a permanent `### Upgrading to 6.x`.

### `docs/USAGE.md`

| Claim | True? | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Nine settings live under Admin → Limits → Desktop" | **No** | Providers, with a pointer for anyone following an older note |
| `FALLBACK_EJECT_SECONDS` "default 3" | **No** — code default `30.0` | Corrected, plus the removed `min(eject_seconds, 1.0)` clamp as the gotcha |
| "Three settings on the **Limits** tab" | **No** (name *and* count) | "Four settings on the **Limits & Resilience** tab" |
| Six cards mentioned but unnamed | Incomplete | Named; "Provider retries & throughput" → "Retries & throughput" |
| Disabled benching fields "dimmed" | Incomplete | Added the literal notes *Not used while eject mode is legacy* / *…while benching is off* |
| Save/unset semantics | Thin | Blank = unset incl. the repo-`.env` masking case, three-state booleans, Save warnings, the six-heading `.env` rewrite |
| Settings reference | **Did not exist** | New appendix, 11 keys, every default read from `Settings.model_fields` |

**Added:** three tutorials — *manage many models*, *read the request detail*, *why my key was benched*.

### `.env.example`

A mechanical diff of every `KEY=` / `# KEY=` line against `Settings.model_fields` (261 fields): **0 keys missing, 0 keys to remove, 0 wrong active values.** Everything the arc added was already present at the right value, and `CREDENTIAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD` was already gone. The **comments** were wrong:

| Where | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| rate-based eject block | "8 min samples, **3s bench**" | **30 s** (`fallback_eject_seconds` = `30.0`) |
| `FALLBACK_EJECT_AFTER_FAILURES` | presented as default behaviour | inert under the default `rate_based` mode; the admin dims it and says so |
| `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_CEILING` | cross-referenced to a setting that never widens; no range, no sentinel | `0` = no ceiling, blank resolves to the default, range `0…1,048,576`, and the TPM-pre-reservation reason it ships set |
| output-tokens intro | ended at "a client value below it is left alone" | + the 6.8.0 widening step; unknown never widens; `max_tokens: 0` stays 0 |
| `CREDENTIAL_LOCKOUT_TIERS` | value only | + ladder meaning and the one-line `CREDENTIAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD` removal note (`extra="ignore"`, so a stale line is inert — delete it) |
| reasoning policy | "providers translate only controls documented by their API" | model knob × host dialect; out-of-vocabulary effort clamps to the nearest rung the host spells, never demoted to the host default |
| `MODEL_VISIBILITY_DENY` | — | + "Hide all" writes one `provider/*` standing-policy entry here |

Template-vs-code divergences enumerated in `test_admin_limits.py::DEFAULTS_THAT_DIFFER_FROM_THE_CODE` were left alone deliberately.

### `ARCHITECTURE.md` (served in the Docs page)

Grep for circuit / half-open / cooldown ladder / first-token budget: **0 hits** — the stale claims were *absent* claims.

| Gap | Fix |
|---|---|
| Rotation and key health not covered at all | New `### Credential Rotation and Key Health`: the two independent allow-lists, the lockout tiers, the exact-`Retry-After` 429 rule, everything-else-moves-to-the-next-MODEL, the deliberate cost (a 5xx-only key is retried per request, not benched), and why no half-open state remains in `core/` |
| "Reasoning Ownership" described only `ReasoningPolicy` + encoders | Added `ReasoningDialect`: declared per encoder/provider, narrowed (never widened) by published `supported_parameters`; the two-fact emission rule; clamp-to-nearest-rung; the toggle rule; nothing-expressible → nothing sent and logged; OpenRouter reference rung + prefer-richer; reject-and-remember (retried once, remembered per process on success only) |
| Output budgets | Added `resolve_max_output_tokens`'s widening plus the four clamps in order |

### In-dashboard Guide (`index.html` `#guide-*`)

| Section | Stale claim | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `#guide-analytics` body pane | no mention that parameters are listed whole | Every top-level key + `extra_body.<name>` above the message structure, **never truncated**; only `messages`/`tools` degrade under `REQUEST_LOG_WIRE_BODY_MAX_CHARS`; what is kept always parses as JSON |
| `#guide-analytics` badge | "a badge appears when gating asked for reasoning and the body carried none" | **Stale since 6.6.0** — badge is `clamped`/`substituted` only; nothing-sent never badges; pre-6.4.0 rows badge nothing |
| `#guide-analytics` | no dash-vs-zero rule, no `(no key available)` | Added, plus the 7-day Models chip |
| `#guide-limits` intro | card names not the shipped labels | Aligned to the six + the sticky section rail |
| `#guide-limits` deadlines | warning not quoted, caveats absent | Quoted warning + the four things the calculator deliberately does not model |
| `#guide-limits` benching | "dimmed and disabled" | Added the explicit per-field notes |
| `#guide-limits` | no ceiling text, no credential-health text | Added both, incl. the removal note |
| `#guide-models` | "Hide all writes one pattern"; "every bulk action offers Undo" | Rewritten as standing policy + "honoured by your glob"; added `/`, `Escape`, Select all N, sticky headers, works while collapsed, inline confirm ≥ 200, `role=status` panel + Undo |
| reasoning | **no section existed** | New `#guide-reasoning` |
| whole file | grep for `circuit`, `HALF_OPEN`, `10/30/60/120`, `MIN_CREDENTIAL_FIRST_TOKEN_SECONDS`, `models.dev`, "Save writes defaults", flat "Limits" | **0 hits** — already carried forward |

### `docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`

Section 4 reframed from "re-capture for the rebrand" to "go stale whenever a view is rebuilt", split into *current as of the 6.x arc* and *still stale, showing a pre-6.x dashboard*. Verified against `ls assets/*.png`, which surfaced `admin-websearch-analytics.png` — present on disk, missing from the old list. Sharpened the two-directory rule: only four filenames existed in both `assets/` and `admin_static/img/`, nothing checks they match, and a refresh means writing the same filename into both.

### `docs/CLAUDE-CODE-CONFIG.md` — deliberately unchanged

It is generated from code.claude.com by `scripts/gen_claude_config_reference.py` and documents **Claude Code's own** knobs. Grep for `MCC` / `FCC` / `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_CEILING` / `MODEL_VISIBILITY` / `REASONING_POLICY`: 0 hits. Hand-editing it would be reverted by the next generator run.

## Screenshots

Recaptured at 6.8.0 against an **isolated** server on port 8199 with `USERPROFILE`/`HOME` redirected to a scratchpad home holding a copy of the real `~/.fcc/.env` and request log, so the frames carry real routing data. Written into **both** `assets/` and `src/my_claude_code/api/admin_static/img/` under the same filenames.

| File | Frame |
|---|---|
| `admin-limits.png` | Limits & Resilience, top — section rail + the Budgets card, ceiling placeholder `131072` and "0 lifts the ceiling entirely" |
| `admin-limits-calculator.png` | The per-route deadline calculator: "each model gets about 67 s", the warning naming the 1080 s budget that would honour 120 s, and the per-route table |
| `admin-models-bulk.png` | Models: sticky provider headers with counts and Show all / Hide all / Invert, the select column, and the "3 selected across 1 provider(s)" action bar |
| `admin-request-detail.png` | Request detail wire pane — parameters first (`model`, `max_tokens`, `tools`, `output_widened_from`, `reasoning_effort`, `stream`, `stream_options`), the `max_tokens 131,072 · raised from 32,000 for reasoning` headline, then the content-first body |
| `admin-request-contradiction.png` | `REASONING EFFORT SUBSTITUTED: … has no effort control; sending a 47616-token thinking budget via reasoning.max_tokens for effort 'max'`, beside the resolved policy and the requested reasoning, with an `ejected` attempt chip |
| `admin-credential-health.png` | Credential health card — the lockout ladder, "this is the only ladder left", "a timeout or 5xx costs a key nothing", per-pool rotation |
| `admin-model-config.png` | Model Config reasoning — per-route selects, "set here" chips, "Use default", `default: inherit` |
| `admin-analytics.png` | Analytics overview at 6.8.0 |

Every frame was inspected before commit: API keys appear only as masked `first4…last4` labels (`user…ubCk`, `sk-n…0awp`), and no prompt, reasoning or response body is visible. Where a pane would have shown prompt text, it was blanked in the DOM before the capture.

## Verification

```
uv run ruff format --check   986 files already formatted
uv run ruff check            All checks passed!
uv run ty check              All checks passed!
uv run pytest -q --tb=line   15 failed, 7598 passed, 38 skipped in 147.64s
```

The 15 failures are the standing baseline that also fails on unmodified `main`: 8 websearch tests reading the real `~/.fcc/.env`, 6 PowerShell installer tests, and `tests/runtime/test_provider_manager.py::test_catalog_publication_tracks_warm_refresh_and_direct_cache`. Nothing new. The docs and asset contract tests all pass, including `tests/contracts/test_admin_asset_wiring.py`, `test_docs_ui_labels.py`, `tests/api/test_docs_page.py`, `test_docs_bundle_wheel.py` and `test_brand_contract.py`. The jsdom harness ran locally (node 24) rather than skipping.

`index.html` and the bundled images are production files, so this bumps `6.8.0 → 6.8.1` with `uv lock` in the same commit.

## Residual risks

- **The Get Started checklist step text is generated by `admin.js`, not `index.html`.** It was read and no pre-6.0 concept was found in it, but it was not rewritten, so a step whose wording drifts with the JS is not covered by this pass.
- **`admin-key-performance.png` may not deserve a refresh at all.** The file exists in `assets/`, but whether a page by that name survived the 6.2.0 reshuffle was not confirmed; the checklist now lists it as stale, where "delete" might be the right answer.
- **The staleness of the seven remaining pre-6.x screenshots is asserted from the release history, not from opening the PNGs.** They were not viewed.
- **The `Shift+Space` selection gesture** is documented in the *manage many models* tutorial from the release notes; `/`, `Escape`, Shift+click and pointer-drag were confirmed in `admin.js`, but no `Shift+Space` handler was located. If it does not exist, that one line is wrong.
- **No visual "contradiction badge" element was found in the request list rows or the modal.** The contradiction is surfaced as a `Reasoning adaptation:` message line, which is what `admin-request-contradiction.png` shows. The Guide's badge prose describes the semantics correctly, but the word "badge" may not match a distinct UI affordance.
- **The README uses the manifest's card headings** ("Output & thinking budgets", "Provider retries & throughput") while the Guide uses the section rail's shorter labels ("Budgets", "Retries & throughput"). Both were verified against the running dashboard and both are literally on screen, but the two documents do not use identical strings.
- **`.env.example` comments were not diffed against the admin manifest's own help prose** (`config/admin/`), which carries its own wording for the same fields. They could drift.
- The screenshots were taken from a copy of the maintainer's own request log, so the model names, providers and error strings in them are real deployment data (no credentials, no message content).

commit.message:
docs: carry every user-facing surface to 6.8.0

The 6.x arc rewrote key health, the Limits page, reasoning resolution, the
request log and the Models page, and the documentation still described the
system as it worked before 6.0.0. A reader following the README or the Guide
was being told to tune a circuit breaker that no longer exists.

What was stale, per surface:

- README: "when rotation happens" listed 5xx/overload and transport failures
  as rotation triggers (6.0.0 rotates on 401/403, 429 and transport only, and
  charges the key on 401/403 and 429 only); `DESKTOP_*` pointed at
  Admin -> Limits -> Desktop (moved to Providers at 6.2.0); the features row
  still said "Limits"; `FALLBACK_EJECT_AFTER_FAILURES` was presented as the
  default benching rule when `FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR` defaults to `rate_based`;
  `FALLBACK_ON_REASONING_ONLY` was pointed at Admin -> Models;
  `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` was missing from the credential-health table;
  the admin page list had neither Models nor Limits & Resilience; and the
  output-budget prose implied the effort rung widens the allowance.
- USAGE: "nine settings under Admin -> Limits -> Desktop"; `FALLBACK_EJECT_SECONDS`
  documented as 3 s when the code default is 30.0; "three settings on the
  Limits tab"; the six cards unnamed; and no settings reference at all.
- .env.example: the rate-based eject block said "3s bench" (30 s);
  `FALLBACK_EJECT_AFTER_FAILURES` was described as the default behaviour rather
  than a `legacy`-mode field the admin dims; `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_CEILING` was
  cross-referenced to a setting that never widens, with no range, no `0`
  sentinel and no blank-resolves-to-default contrast. A mechanical diff of every
  `KEY=` line against `Settings.model_fields` found zero missing or wrong
  values -- the keys were right and the comments were wrong.
- ARCHITECTURE: credential rotation and key health were not covered at all, and
  Reasoning Ownership described only `ReasoningPolicy` with no `ReasoningDialect`.
- Guide: the request-body pane predated 6.8.0's parameters-first wire; the
  contradiction badge still claimed a `dropped` body badges (withdrawn at
  6.6.0); there was no reasoning section at all.
- RELEASE-CHECKLIST: the screenshot list was framed around the rebrand and
  omitted `admin-websearch-analytics.png`.

What is documented now: the rotate-vs-charge allow-lists and the deliberate
cost of never benching on 5xx; the `CREDENTIAL_LOCKOUT_TIERS` ladder and the
exact-`Retry-After` 429 rule; the six Limits & Resilience cards, the per-route
deadline calculator and the four things it does not model; blank-means-unset,
`# KEY= (default: X)` placeholders, three-state booleans and "Use default";
reasoning as model capability x host dialect, the default four-rung
`reasoning_effort`, reject-and-remember, clamp-to-nearest-rung, the toggle rule,
prefer-richer and reasoning room; `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_CEILING` at 131072 with
`0` as the no-ceiling sentinel and why it ships set; the untruncated wire pane,
the dash/zero NULL convention and `(no key available)`; and the Models page
bulk actions, including that "Hide all" writes one `provider/*` glob as a
standing policy. Three tutorials were added to USAGE (manage many models, read
the request detail, why my key was benched) and a permanent "Upgrading to 6.x"
section to the README covering the ceiling default, the `FALLBACK_BENCH_ENABLED`
placeholder and the `CREDENTIAL_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD` removal.

Seven screenshots were recaptured at 6.8.0 against an isolated server on 8199
with `USERPROFILE`/`HOME` redirected to a scratchpad home holding a copy of the
real `.env` and request log, so the frames show real data. Every frame was
inspected before it was committed: keys appear only as masked `first4...last4`
labels and no prompt, reasoning or response body is visible.

Verification: `ruff format --check` (986 files), `ruff check`, repo-wide
`ty check` all clean. Full `pytest -q`: 15 failed, 7598 passed, 38 skipped --
the same 15 that fail on unmodified main (8 websearch reading the real
`~/.fcc/.env`, 6 PowerShell installer, and
test_catalog_publication_tracks_warm_refresh_and_direct_cache). The jsdom
harness ran locally rather than skipping. `index.html` and the bundled images
are production files, so this bumps 6.8.0 -> 6.8.1 with `uv lock`.

Not done: `docs/CLAUDE-CODE-CONFIG.md` is generated from code.claude.com by
scripts/gen_claude_config_reference.py and carries no MCC-behaviour claims, so
it was left alone rather than hand-edited into a state the generator reverts.

USAGE described Shift+Space as selecting "the row under the cursor".
onModelsSelectKeydown in admin.js toggles the whole range from
modelsLastClickedRef to the focused row; it collapses to a single row
only when no anchor has been set yet.
